captions: Tab. 5.5.1 Unit process data of different PV mounting systems
reason: The installation datasets themselves ('3 kWp ... installation, on roof') are not printed as tables anywhere in the report; what IS given is Tab. 5.5.1 on p.61, 'Unit process data of different PV mounting systems', introduced on the same page as 'the life cycle inventory data of mounting' for the roof variants (slanted-roof and flat-roof) — the mounting structure, its materials and the electric installation that make up the installation dataset on top of the panel. The panel itself is a separate upstream dataset (Tab. 5.1.8.2.1-5.1.8.2.6, p.45-49) and Tab. 5.6.1.3/5.6.1.4 are the inverters. So only the mounting part of this dataset is documented, and the report has no caption giving the whole 3 kWp installation.
